Grappling Hook and Rope.name: Grappling Hook and Rope
Grappling Hook and Rope.description: Climbing DL 3 anywhere the hook sticks.

Small Tent.name: Small Tent
Small Tent.description: Set up camp without skill. Space for 2; shelter against rain and wind; reduces any exposure by 1.

Large Tent.name: Large Tent
Large Tent.description: Set up camp without skill. Space for 4; shelter against rain and wind; reduces any exposure by 1.

Oil Lamp.name: Oil Lamp
Oil Lamp.description: 5 m light radius when lit; burns an oil flask for 8 hours.

Flint.name: Flint
Flint.description: Lights a campfire within minutes, no test required.

Firewood.name: Firewood
Firewood.description: Dry wood ready to burn for 4 hours.

Pot.name: Pot
Pot.description: Boils water and cooks up to 10 portions, improving the preparation test by 2.

Chalk.name: Chalk
Chalk.description: Marking a path makes being followed trivial; spent in one ET, lasts until it rains.

Insect Repellant.name: Insect Repellant
Insect Repellant.description: Reduces exposure to insects by 2; lasts for 1 sleep.

Fur Cloak.name: Fur Cloak
Fur Cloak.description: Improves resistance to cold exposure by +2.

Camouflage.name: Camouflage
Camouflage.description: For one terrain. +3 to Stealth vs vision outside combat; -3 in combat in plain sight.

Snow Shoes.name: Snow Shoes
Snow Shoes.description: Cancels the penalty for walking in snow.
